q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
web/src/connect.ts
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
store/memo.go
store/db/sqlite/memo.go
```

Hop by hop:

`useCreateMemo` (line 178 of `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`) is a TanStack `useMutation` whose `mutationFn` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })`. On success it invalidates the memo lists and user stats and seeds the detail cache with the new memo.

`memoServiceClient` is the generated `MemoService` client built on the shared transport in `web/src/connect.ts` (line 197).

The RPC is `CreateMemo` at line 21 of `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`, annotated `POST /api/v1/memos` with `body: "memo"` (q01). Over the wire the frontend uses Connect rather than the REST gateway, but both terminate at the same handler (q19).

`APIV1Service.CreateMemo` at line 70 of `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` does validation and permission work, then calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at line 115.

`Store.CreateMemo` at line 109 of `store/memo.go` checks the UID against `base.UIDMatcher` and delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` through the `Driver` interface (q08).

`DB.CreateMemo` at line 16 of `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` builds the statement at line 41:

```41:41:/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go
	stmt := "INSERT INTO `memo` (" + strings.Join(fields, ", ") + ") VALUES (" + strings.Join(placeholder, ", ") + ") RETURNING `id`, `created_ts`, `updated_ts`, `row_status`"
```

The MySQL and Postgres equivalents live at the same path with the dialect swapped, selected at startup by `NewDBDriver` (q18).

Note this is the direct path. A comment creation enters at `CreateMemoComment` and reaches the same chain one level down by calling `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` internally (q11), and after the insert the handler fans out to the SSE hub (q20) and user webhooks (q22).
